_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Training Systems Sustainment Bill of Materials (TSS BOM)
summary: The TSS BOM captures support and logistics engineering data from contractors to establish production status, identify supply chain risks, and manage DMSMS-related hardware and software obsolescence for training systems.
use_relationship:
The Training Systems Sustainment Bill of Materials (TSS BOM) comprises the support and support-related engineering and logistics data acquired from contractors using support analysis information collected during the design, development, and initial fielding process of a training system or training end item. This includes data for maintenance planning, logistics design requirements, reliability and maintainability, system safety, supply support, initial sparing, and item management; providing information that can be used to establish the production status of parts used in a training system and identify supply chain risks so they can be mitigated during the development of the training system.
This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
The TSS BOM will also provide Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Material Shortages (DMSMS) management-essential information that enables the identification, forecasting, mitigation, and management of Hardware and Software obsolescence as a part of the Department of Defense (DoD) Program Manager's Total System Life Cycle Management responsibilities. The data will be used in DMSMS forecasting tools to allow for standard and efficient sharing of information on common items.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: Tab 1.
children.content: The BOM shall contain all of the information specified in Figure 1, with the path to each system level using the part/Next Higher Assembly method. The information shall be included to the lowest indenture level (component level) specified in the contract. All fields shall be included. Fields which do not require data shall be indicated as "N/A".

children.title: Tab 2.
children.content: The Supporting Data shall be a Product Data Sheet (PDS) for each recommended spare. In the event a PDS is not available, an engineering drawing or specification will suffice. Each supporting data file recommended as a spare shall be an embedded PDF in the spreadsheet, titled with item PLISN and Part Number (P/N) in sequence with the items on the BOM tab. A hyperlink shall be contained to link the PLISN on BOM tab to embedded corresponding supporting data file.
